description:
This is a special, one-season release of the *Mission Shift* podcast from IVP author, Josh Irby. To continue listening to the podcast after Episode 5, subscribe to the full *Mission Shift* podcast here:
* Apple Podcasts ( https://www.cru.org/us/en/train-and-grow/audio/mission-shift.html#s )
* Spotify ( https://www.cru.org/us/en/train-and-grow/audio/mission-shift.html#season1 )
* iHeartRadio ( https://www.iheart.com/podcast/263-mission-shift-podcast-93602039 )
* Podcast Addict ( https://podcastaddict.com/podcast/mission-shift-podcast/3986163 )
Mission Shift is a podcast exploring how global missions is changing, especially as mission leadership and engagement increasingly come from everywhere to everywhere. Through conversations with global leaders, practitioners, and thinkers, each episode helps listeners pursue missions with humility, partnership, and wisdom.
*Welcome to Season 3 of Mission Shift*
“How does crosscultural partnership amplify global missions?” Let’s talk about it!
Building directly on previous seasons—which shined a spotlight on the global church on mission (Season 1) and explored how the West can best partner with them (Season 2)—this season dives into the central theme of cross-cultural partnership through the lens of the biblical figure Barnabas.
As the “modern missions era” gives way to the “new era of missions” and mission activity morphs from “the west to the rest” to “everywhere to everywhere,” Barnabas’ approach to mission is a compelling model to examine and learn from.
Throughout the season, we dialog with an array of international mission leaders and authors to unpack topics from the new InterVarsity Press book, The Barnabas Factor ( https://www.ivpress.com/the-barnabas-factor ). We’ll explore how humility, advocacy, mutual accountability, relational presence, and other factors can amplify global mission efforts in a shifting world.

From the Great Fire of Rome to the London of 1666, from the Wisconsin fire tornado that killed more people than the Chicago fire that made the headlines, to the oil fields of Kuwait, to the modern wildfire that erased a California town in a single night, Inferno is honest about the difference between the legend and the record. description:
You only get one shot to win over a new podcast listener. Which means you need to make your first impression count. 

That's where we come in. 

In every episode, we roast one of our listener's show's podcast packaging to identify what they're doing well to attract new listeners... and where they're likely turning people off. 

Step by step, we walk through the typical podcast listener acquisition process and dissect each show's title, cover art, show description, episode titles & descriptions, and more.

The idea is simple: relaxed conversations with interesting people and stories worth sharing. I want every episode to feel as if you’re sitting in the room with us.
Interesting people. Unexpected stories. Pull up a chair, you’re invited.

The goal is to captivate the listener by breaking down each version and sharing stories, opinions and favorites along the way. The mission of the show is to entertain, amuse and educate. title: Crime Under Silence
author: OBOMEDIA ENTERTAINMENT
description:
Uncover the chilling truths hidden beneath the surface. Crime Under Silence delves into the most perplexing real-life mysteries and unsolved cases that defy explanation. We meticulously examine the evidence, explore the darkest corners of human nature, and bring to light the stories that the world tried to forget.

Each day, Crime Under Silence presents a new deep dive into true crime, from baffling disappearances to cold cases finally cracked. Our episodes are released daily, Monday through Sunday, at 4:00 AM, ensuring you always have a fresh dose of suspense to start your day. We go beyond the headlines to give you the full, unvarnished picture of criminal investigations and the people involved.

This podcast is for anyone fascinated by forensic science, criminal psychology, and the relentless pursuit of justice. If you crave gripping narratives and detailed accounts of true crime stories, then Crime Under Silence is your essential daily listen. Subscribe now and join us in our quest to expose the truth.

title: Escape Velocity with Craig Ceccanti
author: Craig Ceccanti
description: Most business stories are highlight reels. Escape Velocity isn't. Host Craig Ceccanti, a founder, CEO, and integrator who has spent his career growing and scaling companies across retail, tech, and venture (including Pinot's Palette), and now helps leadership teams do the same as an EOS Implementer, sits down with operators and the people who advise them for the real version: the hire that nearly sank the company, the year the founder stopped sleeping, the moment they realized they had become the bottleneck. Every guest walks through a hard-won lesson: what happened, how they recovered, and how it made the business more sustainable. It is about the unglamorous middle, where a company either learns to run without its founder or stalls. Pull up a chair. We would love to have you in the conversation.

title: JIPANGE SUNDAY
author: Dr. Job Mogire
description: Jipange Sunday is a weekly practice for people who want to protect their attention, structure the week before noise takes over, and move important work forward. Hosted by Dr. Job Mogire, each episode offers clear thinking, practical planning, and accountable action for your work, family, health, and the life you are building. Usipojipanga, utapangwa.

author: MDPOE
description: Are you struggling in life? Depression, substance abuse, divorce, anger, or any other type of addiction? Are you using substances or distractions to help numb your mind? Are you tired of the status quo? When was the last time that you contemplated life impacting questions? Questions that I believe every person should ask themselves. It's my hope that I can lead you to discover the same peace that I have been able to discover in my life after struggling for years. A peace that will change your life. Join me for discussions that cover a variety of topics that will challenge and encourage you.

title: Women [In]...
author: Sondra Connor
description:
Every woman is a woman in something.


Women in tech. Women in energy, trades, trucking, nursing, nonprofits, the back office nobody thanks. Each episode, host Sondra Connor talks to one woman about the field she works in, how she got there, and what it actually cost her.


Not a panel. Not a keynote. No book to plug. Just one person describing what her job looks like once the LinkedIn filter comes off... the bad supervisor, the good one, the raise that didn't fix anything, the Tuesday she almost quit.


The point isn't inspiration. It's information. You can't want a job you've never heard of, and most careers happen in the unglamorous middle that nobody writes about.

The brackets are on purpose. You fill them in.


New episodes all season. Want to be a guest? You don't need a book, a keynote, or a following... just a job you actually do. sondra@cheekyrooster.com

title: Rugged Water: An Unexpected Captain
author: Joseph Crosby Lincoln
description:
Calvin Homer, Surfman Number One, has always envisioned himself as the captain of the Setuckit Life-Saving Station, a role that comes with the weight of responsibility and honor. But when an outsider with a mysterious past is promoted instead, everything changes. As the crew grapples with their loyalty to Calvin and the unsettling presence of the newcomer, tensions rise, and trust begins to unravel.

Rugged Water dives deep into the heart of camaraderie and conflict, exploring the dynamics of a tight-knit team pitted against the unknown. Listeners will be drawn into the gripping challenges faced by the surfmen, from daring rescues in treacherous waters to the haunting secrets that the new captain brings along. The rugged life on Cape Cod becomes a backdrop for an intense exploration of ambition, rivalry, and the search for identity.

With every wave crashing against the shore, the stakes grow higher. Will Calvin reclaim his rightful place, or will the outsider’s hidden agenda change everything for the crew? Discover the intricate layers of loyalty, courage, and betrayal in this action-packed audiobook that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Rugged Water is not just a tale of survival; it’s a journey into the depths of human connection and the trials that define us. Join Calvin and the surfmen as they navigate not only the waters but also their own hearts.

title: P. P. C.: A Murder Mystery
author: Natalie Sumner Lincoln
description:
Mary Langhorne's lifeless body lies in a taxi, just blocks from her father's home, thrusting her into the center of a tangled web of intrigue and betrayal. Newly married to Senator Rags Langhorne, Mary seemed to have it all—wealth, beauty, and a promising future. But as the police scramble to untangle the threads of her murder, they uncover a chilling second death: Carl Ashby, a former lover, is poisoned under suspicious circumstances.

What connects these two deaths? The cryptic letters P.P.C. appear in the most unexpected places, leading investigators down a rabbit hole of secrets and lies. With each clue, the stakes rise, revealing hidden connections that shake the foundations of both the elite social circle and the law enforcement community.

In this gripping detective fiction by Natalie Sumner Lincoln, listeners will embark on a suspenseful journey through jealousy, ambition, and the darker sides of love. Can the investigators decipher the meaning of P.P.C. before another life is claimed? Join the hunt for answers in a mystery where every character has something to hide, and the truth is more elusive than it seems. Perfect for fans of classic whodunits, "P. P. C." will keep you on the edge of your seat, wondering who can be trusted and what secrets lie just beneath the surface.

title: Creeping Things Podcast
author: Hilda and Susan
description:
Welcome to Creeping Things Podcast, where we’ve combined our love for travel, creeping animals, and learning into one fun space.
Each week, we take you to a new country, and each of us chooses one creeping animal from that part of the world to learn about. Then we come together and teach each other what we discovered, which means you get to learn about two incredible animals in every episode right along with us.
Even if you didn’t start out loving the “unloved,” we hope that by the end of each episode, you’ll make a little space in your heart for them.
First episode airs September 2nd 2026

title: Celebrated Crimes: The Borgias & the Cenci - Volume 1
author: Alexandre Dumas
description:
In the cutthroat world of 15th-century Italy, the infamous Borgia family rises to power through a deadly mix of ambition, betrayal, and scandal. Alexandre Dumas delves deep into the chilling legacy of the Borgias, unraveling a story that intertwines political machinations with personal vendettas. As the notorious Pope Alexander VI orchestrates a web of intrigue, listeners will witness the lengths to which individuals will go to secure their place in history, including murder, deception, and manipulation.

But the dark narrative doesn't end there. Dumas also brings to light the tragic tale of the Cenci family, whose desperate fight against corruption and injustice culminates in a harrowing act of vengeance. This gripping volume explores themes of morality, power, and the human condition, raising questions about the price of justice in a world where the line between right and wrong is often blurred.

With each chapter, you’ll find yourself drawn into a labyrinth of historical events that challenge your perceptions of heroism and villainy. Dumas's vivid storytelling and unflinching honesty create a captivating experience that will leave you questioning the true nature of crime and legacy. Join us on this enthralling journey through time, where every twist reveals the dark side of ambition and the haunting echoes of celebrated crimes. Perfect for true crime enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this audiobook promises to keep you on the edge of your seat.

description:
Hooking Up with Dr. B and Rasheed brings together Dr. Adele Schwartz Benzaken, a physician and sexual health expert who has pretty much heard it all, and Rasheed Gonga, a gay man just trying to live his best life.
Together, they’re talking about sex, pleasure, relationships, sexual health, and all the wonderfully awkward questions that come with being human. From hookups and orgasms to erections, kinks, STIs, PrEP, and everything in between, no question is too embarrassing and nothing is off limits.
Come for the questions you’ve been afraid to ask. Stay for the answers you didn’t know you needed.
Let’s hook up.

title: Enjoy Life Healthier™ Podcast with Jason Kam
author: Purity Products®
description:
Enjoy Life Healthier is not just another health podcast — it’s a platform where untold stories and groundbreaking research come to life.

From the latest developments in longevity research to breakthrough discoveries in brain science, from innovative approaches to stress management to cutting-edge nutritional insights, Jason and his guests dive deep into health topics that impact not only your day-to-day life, but the life you will lead for years to come. Rather than recycling familiar wellness narratives, Enjoy Life Healthier ventures into uncharted territory, bringing fresh perspectives and evidence-based insights to light. Enjoy Life Healthier is not just another health podcast — it’s a platform where untold stories and groundbreaking research come to life.

The result is more than just engaging conversations — it’s a roadmap for listeners seeking to optimize their health and embrace the art of aging well. Through thoughtful dialogue and expert insights, Jason creates a space where complex science becomes accessible and actionable wisdom. Whether you’re a health professional seeking to expand your knowledge or someone passionate about taking control of your wellbeing, Enjoy Life Healthier offers an enlightening journey into the future of science and vitality.

title: The Adventures of Ferdinand Count Fathom: A Life of Deception
author: Tobias Smollett
description:
Dr. Fathom, a master of deception, navigates a world where truth is as scarce as honor. Born to a soldier’s harlot and wrapped in a shroud of mystery, his life unfolds like a grand tapestry of adventures filled with charm, betrayal, and relentless ambition. As he forges his identity through cunning and charisma, he finds himself embroiled in schemes that test his wit and resilience. From the opulent salons of the elite to the gritty underbelly of society, Fathom's journey is a thrilling exploration of identity and the lengths one will go to achieve greatness.

In 'Adventures of Ferdinand Count Fathom,' Tobias Smollett invites listeners to unravel the complexities of a protagonist who thrives on manipulation. Can a man born from the ashes of dishonor truly rise to prominence, or will his lies catch up with him? Each encounter shapes Fathom's path, revealing the stark contrasts between appearances and reality.

This audiobook immerses you in a world where every character has a tale to tell, and every choice leads to unexpected consequences. Discover how Fathom's charm captivates those around him, even as it leads him into precarious situations. With humor and insight, Smollett crafts a narrative that keeps you questioning the nature of truth and ambition. Join Fathom on this rollercoaster of adventure, where every twist and turn promises to challenge your perceptions and ignite your curiosity.

title: Chef Mic Podcast

description: The Chef Mic Podcast is uncensored, unfiltered, and out of pocket—mixing real-life stories, blue-collar humor, wild news, and everyday topics people actually talk about. Hosted by Chef Mic with occasional guests and co-hosts, the show says what everyone else is thinking and keeps it funny, honest, and unpredictable.

description:
Becoming champions and top-tier sports broadcasters doesn't come easy, and balancing that with motherhood and partnership is a masterclass in resilience.
 
Join USWNT legend Carli Lloyd and FOX Sports’ Jenny Taft for WHATEVER IT TAKES, a series where two friends who have been, and continue to be, at the top of their games discuss the week in sports, family, and the ever evolving definition of greatness.

title: At the Mountains of Madness: A Chilling Expedition into the Unknown
author: H. P. Lovecraft
description:
A scientific expedition to Antarctica uncovers an ancient civilization that challenges everything humanity knows about its past. When the team stumbles upon the eerie ruins of the Elder Things, beings that thrived on Earth millions of years ago, they ignite a chilling exploration into the unknown. What secrets lie buried in the ice, and could these ancient entities still inhabit our world?

As the expedition unfolds, the crew grapples with horrifying revelations that blur the line between science and the supernatural. Strange artifacts, inexplicable phenomena, and a creeping sense of dread lead them to question not only their own sanity but the very fabric of reality. With each discovery, the stakes rise, and the question remains: are the Elder Things truly extinct, or have they merely bided their time, waiting for the right moment to reemerge?

At the Mountains of Madness is not just a tale of terror; it’s a journey into the depths of human curiosity and the perilous consequences of unearthing the past. Join this gripping audiobook experience that weaves together cosmic horror, ancient mysteries, and the fragility of existence. Perfect for fans of Lovecraftian lore and those who crave a chilling narrative that lingers long after the last word. Will you dare to listen?

title: Catriona: Adventures of David Balfour
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description:
On the very day that David Balfour escapes his dire fate from Kidnapped, he finds himself entangled in a web of intrigue that could cost him everything. In Catriona, Robert Louis Stevenson invites listeners into David's relentless pursuit of justice as he battles to clear the names of both himself and the innocent James Stewart, accused of a crime that could lead to his execution. With the powerful Campbell clan determined to see Stewart hang, David must navigate treacherous alliances and dangerous enemies, all while grappling with his own sense of honor and loyalty.

As he journeys through the Scottish Highlands, David encounters Catriona, a spirited and resourceful young woman whose courage and wit challenge his beliefs and ignite a spark of romance. Together, they unravel secrets hidden within the shadows, confronting the harsh realities of betrayal and the fight for truth in a world rife with deception.

Listeners will be captivated by the rich character development and vivid storytelling that brings this tale of adventure and heart to life. Stevenson weaves themes of justice, love, and the quest for redemption into a narrative that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Discover how David's journey unfolds as he faces perilous choices and learns that not all battles are fought with swords. Will he uncover the truth in time, or will the forces against him prove too strong? Dive into Catriona and find out!

description: Flotilla Voices features Dr. Frank Romano, a participant in both the 2025 and 2026 Global Sumud Flotillas. He brings you conversations with other activists who participated in these relief efforts, updates on new plans for the relief of Gaza, and descriptions of his experiences - including torture at the hands of the IDF - as a result of the flotillas and from decades of peace activism in Palestine and Israel. Dr. Romano earned a PhD at the Sorbonne in Paris, is a retired law professor at University of Paris and adjunct professor at Golden Gate University, and is the author of the books Storm Over Morocco and Love and Terror in the Middle East.

title: Off The Shot List
author: Christina & Will
description:
Weddings brought us here. Life gave us the rest of the story.


We’re Will and Christina, the husband-and-wife team behind The MacMeekens Photography. After more than a decade of photographing weddings and building a business, family, and wonderfully unconventional life together, we’ve learned that the best stories are rarely the ones anyone planned.


Off the Shot List is where we talk about all of it: weddings, marriage, creative work, homeschooling, neurodivergence, parenting, rock climbing, travel, and whatever else life puts in front of us.


Some episodes will help you plan a wedding that actually feels like you. Others may have absolutely nothing to do with weddings. Every episode is an honest, occasionally messy, and hopefully hilarious conversation about building a life together....and everything that happens outside the frame.

title: The Community Podcast: The Upper East Side
author: Chris Murray
description:
Welcome to The Upper East Side, part of The Community Podcast, where we put the spotlight on the people, places, and stories shaping Central Iowa's northeast communities. Covering Ankeny, Altoona, Bondurant, Pleasant Hill, and surrounding communities, it's your connection to what's happening across this growing part of Central Iowa.
Hosted by Chris Murray, The Upper East Side features conversations with local leaders, business owners, organizations, and community members who know these communities best. Each episode takes you behind the businesses, projects, initiatives, and ideas making an impact throughout the area.
From new developments and local businesses to community events, organizations, and people doing great things, The Upper East Side brings local stories to the forefront. It's a place to stay informed, discover what's new, and get to know more about the communities around you.
Tune in to The Upper East Side and discover more of the community around you. Every conversation is an opportunity to share local stories, strengthen connections, and bring people together as we continue building stronger communities across Central Iowa.

title: Clinically Chaotic
author: Ericka and Tara
description:
Therapy is serious work. So why are the funniest stories the ones we can’t say out loud?



Welcome to Clinically Chaotic. Featuring Ericka and Tara—two therapists bringing professional insight and therapist-level humor to the real realities of the field. This show is about therapist comedy with substance: candid conversations on what happens in the room, behind the notes, and after a long day of holding space.



If you’re a clinician, student, or just curious about mental health from the inside, you’ll get unfiltered honesty, practical perspective, and a few much-needed laughs. Take a breath—let’s get into it.

title: Virtual Health Revolution
author: Karen Lea
description: *Welcome to 'The Virtual Health Revolution,' the podcast dedicated to inspiring health coaches and clinic owners like you to explore the heights of your potential in the digital era*

title: The Top5Cast
author: Gabe Ketchum
description:
It’s not really a game show… it’s a test of how well you know your best friend.
Welcome to the show where friendship, opinions, and questionable rankings collide. Each episode, two people—preferably best friends—go head-to-head in a simple challenge: one ranks five things/scenarios, while the other has to guess exactly how their friend ranked them.
Match a ranking? You get a point. Miss it? Prepare to defend your friendship.
Across pop culture, food, sports, etc., no two rounds are quite the same. Stay for the chaos, the debates, and the friendships that may never be the same.

title: The Under The Dome Podcast
author: Mark Des Cotes
description: A podcast dedicated to the CBS show Under The Dome based on Stephen King's novel. Send in your thoughts and theories each week to feedback@solotalkmedia.com or call 1-805-910-7656

description: Northwest Arkansas' Radio Station

title: Barely Brown
author: Arnav and Neelesh
description:
Two soft Indians in their 30s exploring life, niche interests, and absurd ideas. 
Come for the chaos, stay for even more chaos. From New Zealand to Canada, we're bringing that Indian masala, one episode at a time.

title: Holy Joys Catechism Podcast
author: Johnathan Arnold
description: A podcast on the basics of the Christian faith for inquirers, catechumens, and lifelong disciples who want to strengthen their foundations. Each episode expounds a question of The Whole Counsel of God: A Protestant Catechism and Discipleship Handbook (Holy Joys, 2025).

title: Scotland's Survivors Movement - A Living History
author: Eighteen and Under
description:
Episode 3 - 4th September
In 2025, the children’s abuse charity Eighteen and Under secured funding from the National Lottery Heritage Fund in order to capture the living history of the many activists instrumental in the creation of services in Scotland for survivors of childhood sexual abuse. 
The legacy these people created has changed lives, healed lives and saved lives. And this podcast aims to share this legacy with future generations, showing them that there is always a way to create what is needed, when it’s needed, when determined people work together against inequality and injustice.

title: Corner Piece
author: TED
description:
Corner Piece starts small on life’s biggest questions. Join Taha, Melissa, and Sabrina (lifelong friends, full-time nerds) as they connect their personal questions to the profound nature of being a person. Using the skills they learned documenting their curiosity on their YouTube channel, Answer in Progress, they start with a day-to-day question or worry, like: Is there a right way to split the bill? Why does it feel so hard to hang out these days? Is romance dead? Then, they launch an investigation. They interview experts, go on side quests, and figure out how much of their problems are caused by the complexity of modern life… and how much is just a part of the human experience. New episodes every other Thursday.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: B&H Photography Podcast
author: B&H Photo & Video
description: The B&H Photography Podcast: Join us every other week for a conversation with insightful and entertaining guests. From gear and technique to history, science and art, we discuss the issues most important to the contemporary photographer.

title: Hey..I Hope You're Happy
author: EchoToYou
description:
Hey... I Hope You're Happy is a collection of quiet thoughts, unsent letters, and late-night musings about love, loss, healing, faith, and the conversations we have with ourselves when no one else is listening.
Some stories are personal. Others are imagined. All of them explore what it means to be human—to love deeply, to grieve honestly, to question everything, and to keep searching for peace.
If you've ever replayed a memory, missed someone you couldn't reach, or found comfort in words that felt like they were written just for you...
I hope you find a little of yourself here.

title: The Excuse
author: Joshua Boyt
description: Coffee is just the excuse to be together.  The Excuse is a weekly show hosted by Joshua Boyt — 25 years in the specialty coffee industry, built on relationships first. Every Tuesday, Joshua gathers around the proverbial cup to explore what happens when coffee becomes the permission slip for real conversation: about business, identity, craft, community, and the kind of purpose that outlasts a trend.  Solo episodes dig into the frameworks Joshua has spent a career building — how we impress before we express, why a compass matters more than a clock, and what it looks like to find the work you were made for. Guest conversations go deep with the people who have shaped the specialty coffee world and beyond.  This isn't a show about coffee. It's a show about people — and coffee just happens to be the reason we showed up.  New episodes every Tuesday. Pull up a chair.

title: Listen Local Lehigh Valley
author: WMUH - Muhlenberg College
description: Discussions with artists from the Lehigh Valley scene and beyond.

author: The Athletic
description:
The Athletic Live functions as a nightly, community-driven digital broadcast on YouTube, uniting subscribers, editorial staff, and digital personalities within the industry's premier sports-centric dialogue.


The programming shifts between immersive second-screen watch-along coverage for marquee matchups and analytical reaction segments focused on the most pressing headlines across the landscape during off-nights.


This platform provides a unique opportunity for the audience to engage directly with our network of reporters and specialists, ensuring their perspectives are part of the broader discussion surrounding their preferred franchises and professional circuits.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

author: Mary Abbott
description:
Real conversations about educator wellness, retention, and the future of education

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Floor Is Yours
author: Dr. Kyle Hartman
description: Hosted by pelvic floor physical therapist Dr. Kyle Hartman, The Floor Is Yours is a podcast where science meets storytelling. Through honest conversations about pelvic health, sex, business, relationships, and life, you'll leave feeling informed, empowered, and a little more connected to yourself.

title: Casually Biased
author: Sideliner
description:
Casually Biased, a Sideliner production, is your weekly dose of sports opinions, heavy on college football, with zero pretense of objectivity. 
We call our shots, argue our bias, and apologize for nothing; all with the game knowledge to back it up.
@CasualBiasShow
Sideliner | @SidelinerHQ | SidelinerHQ.com | Contact@SidelinerHQ.com

title: ["Lehigh Valley Landmarks", "Lehigh Valley Landmarks"]
author: WDIY 88.1 FM
description: Bethlehem’s City Councilwoman and Vice President Rachel Leon presents Bethlehem, Pennsylvania’s historic landmarks that capture the stories, places, events and innovations which affected the lives of Pennsylvanians throughout the centuries.Listen weekly to learn why Bethlehem was included as part of a larger transnational listing that made the 26th UNESCO World Heritage site and about the history of more than 100 historic markers.

title: The Altar Call Podcast
author: Jessica Dickerson
description:
The Altar Call is a Bible-centered podcast dedicated to teaching Apostolic truth. Each episode breaks down Scripture, answers real questions, and explores what it truly means to live a Spirit-filled life.
If you're hungry for truth, or seeking a deeper walk with God, this podcast is for you. Expect biblical teaching, honest conversations, powerful testimonies, and practical guidance for living a life that honors God.

title: Common Ground by Scion
author: Scion
description:
Common Ground by Scion brings together the people, perspectives and ideas shaping property, construction and the built environment.

From the story behind Scion to the full journey of our developments — from site acquisition and planning through design, construction, sales and delivery — we take you behind the scenes of what it really takes to bring a project to life.

Along the way, we’re joined by industry peers, partners and specialists to share different perspectives, unpack the challenges facing our industry and have open conversations about where it’s heading.

From project milestones and industry events to lessons learned on the ground, Common Ground is a place to share experiences, challenge ideas and find the perspectives that move our industry forward.

Because the best conversations start when we find common ground.

title: actually, though with Logan
author: Logan
description: Life, dating, friendships, hot takes, questionable decisions, and everything we’re figuring out along the way. Actually, Though is basically the conversation you’d have with your best friend after saying, “Okay wait, but actually though…” No expert advice here — just Logan figuring it out with you.

title: WHS Hotline: ask & answer
author: Shahjalal raihan
description: A WHS Hotline provides guidance on workplace hazards, mental health risks, ergonomic rights, and confidential reporting protocols for workers.

title: The Supplier Side
author: Warner Norcross + Judd
description:
The Supplier Side: Legal Insights for the Automotive Supply Chain is a podcast from Warner Norcross + Judd LLP focused exclusively on the legal and commercial issues facing automotive suppliers.
Hosted by members of Warner’s Automotive Industry Group, the podcast explores the real-world challenges suppliers navigate every day — including supply chain disputes, pricing and commercial negotiations, warranty and quality claims, litigation, distressed suppliers, contracts, tariffs and evolving industry pressures. Drawing on decades of experience representing suppliers throughout the automotive supply chain, each episode delivers practical insights designed to help businesses identify risks, protect operations and make informed strategic decisions.
Whether you’re in-house counsel, an executive, a supply chain professional or part of a commercial team, The Supplier Side offers timely conversations grounded in the realities of today’s automotive industry.

title: Fullcrcl
author: Justin Cain
description: Fullcrcl is a podcast where Faith and Community Meet.

title: The Not Done Yet Movement Podcast
author: The Not Done Yet Movement
description: The Not Done Yet Movement Podcast is a space for honest conversations with women navigating confidence, friendship, reinvention, purpose, and the many chapters of life that are still waiting to be written. Hosted by Valerie Rae Brown, each episode explores the stories, lessons, challenges, and possibilities that remind us that no matter where we are in life, we are not done yet.

title: The Inner Home Journey
author: Vanessa Leon-Gonzalez
description: The Inner Home Journey is a guided exploration of your inner world. Led by psychotherapist and trauma specialist Vanessa Leon-Gonzalez, LCSW, these meditations and reflective practices draw from Internal Family Systems (IFS) and trauma-informed approaches. You’ll be invited to meet the parts of you that work hard, worry, protect, criticize, or carry old pain—not to fix or get rid of them, but to listen, understand, and build a more compassionate relationship with yourself. No prior experience is needed. Just come as you are. Welcome home.

title: UnPlayed: The Truth of Underage Betting
author: UnPlayed
description: Unplayed is a youth-focused podcast examining how sports betting is changing the way young people experience sports. Each episode breaks down gambling ads, marketing tactics, league and government responses, and the risks of underage betting in a clear and practical way. Through current events, real examples, interviews, and prevention strategies, Unplayed helps teens, parents, coaches, and schools better understand how gambling reaches young audiences and what can be done about it.

title: Farm Stress Real Talk with Penn State Extension
author: Penn State Extension
description: The Farm Stress podcast focuses on supporting farmers, farm families, and workers in the commercial agriculture industry who are experiencing stress. In each podcast, we will tackle topics that challenge our farming community, provide constructive suggestions, and build awareness around the potentially stressful conditions affecting farmers.

title: Corporate Dropout
author: Troy Cicotte and Miles Baguette
description: Corporate Dropout is more than just a podcast; it's a cultural shift. We chronicle the journeys of those who took the leap from traditional paths to build their own empires. From creators to serial entrepreneurs, we dive deep into the mindset, the failures, and the massive wins of the people redefining what "work" looks like in the 21st century.

title: Better Than Vibes

description: Learning to apply solid engineering principles to AI-assisted software development.

title: Frank Conversations
author: Frank Schofield
description:
What happens when you sit down and have a real conversation?

In Frank Conversations, Superintendent Frank Schofield sits down with the people who make our schools and community special. Teachers, students, coaches, staff, and others, to hear their stories, experiences, ideas, and perspectives.

These are honest, sometimes funny, and always personal conversations about education, school, and the people behind it all. No speeches. No talking points. Just frank conversations.

title: On The Record
author: Michael Rutkowski
description: We are all going to die one day, so we might as well talk about it. Estate planning attorney Michael Rutkowski has spent over 20 years helping families protect what matters most, and now he is breaking it all down for you. Trusts, wills, tax planning, powers of attorney, the stuff nobody teaches you but everybody needs. Every week Mike cuts through the legalese and makes one of life's most important conversations actually make sense. Because if you do not have a plan, your state already made one for you. Now you have a friend in estate planning. Welcome to On The Record.

title: Exploring the Kingdom
author: Project Aureole
description:
Welcome to "Exploring the Kingdom," your wild, Christocentric escapade into the endless possibilities in Christ! We demystify biblical concepts, metaphors, and shadows, revealing Jesus as the glorious substance. Each episode offers practical, spirit-stirring sessions to enlighten and ignite believers.
Warning: Expect some serious religious cow-tipping! We're here to dismantle stale traditions with the liberating, intoxicating message of God's extravagant love and grace. Subscribe now and join the revolution—let's get wild in the wonders of Christ's Kingdom together!
Grace and Peace

Lakewood Church, Houston, Texas. One of the largest American pastoral audiences internationally; his ministry reaches people through television, books and online media.

title: College Unfiltered
author: James Watkins, Ethan Couch, Luke Brown
description: College Unfiltered is a podcast about experiencing college life in the real world. Hosted by three college students, each episode dives into honest conversations about what it’s really like to navigate university life. From classes, friendships, and campus life to stress, independence, personal growth, and the challenges that come with becoming an adult, the hosts bring personal stories, different perspectives, and plenty of humor to the table. College Unfiltered is a place for real conversations about the college experience—beyond the classroom and without the filter

title: Becoming Anyway Pod
author: Kelly MacPherson and Lauren Maddern
description:
Two generations. Two perspectives. One conversation.
Becoming Anyway is a Mother + Daughter Podcast with Kelly MacPherson and Lauren Maddern about life, the stories we tell about it, and everything we're still figuring out along the way.
From family, careers and relationships to sports, technology, culture, travel, memories, mistakes, and whatever has us saying, "We're doing this now?" Nothing is really off the table.
We're often on the same page. How we got there can be an entirely different story.
Real conversation. Honest perspective. Plenty of laughs.
New Episodes Drop Every Thursday

title: The Suite Spot: Create an Offer Suite That Sells Itself
author: Sandra van der Lee, High-Ticket Offer Strategist
description:
The Suite Spot it the podcast for online business owners, entrepreneurs, and thought leaders that want to package up their expertise into offers that sell. This podcast about offer creation and sales will help you with messaging, creating your offers, and making high-ticket sales. No matter if you're brand new or have packaged up and sold your expertise for years, this podcast is for you!
This show is brought to you by Sandra van der Lee, a high-ticket offer strategist for course creators, coaches, consultants, and service providers. Learn more about creating and selling your offers at sandravanderlee.com

title: The AndyTV Experince based off TikTok
author: A,L Production
description: this is the the first ever radio podcast of the AndyTV Experience based off tiktok.

title: Beyond the Tour - College of Charleston
author: Cam Saleeby
description: Are you prospective student visiting the College of Charleston? A family member helping your student navigate the admissions process? This podcast is for you! Let us pull the curtain back on the visit experience at the College of Charleston. Beyond the Tour takes you beyond your campus visit with helpful conversations, practical advice, and insights to help you make the most of your college search. From understanding your visit to navigating the next steps, this podcast is here to help you feel informed, confident, and connected throughout your journey.

title: The Spiritual Man
author: Elshammah Daniels
description:
The Spiritual Man is a Christian media ministry dedicated to helping believers grow in their relationship with God, become transformed into the likeness of Christ, and learn to live by the Holy Spirit.
Here we explore prayer, the Word of God, spiritual growth, hearing God, the gifts and fruit of the Spirit, Kingdom living, spiritual discernment, prophecy, and the believer's mission to the world.
Our desire is not merely to inform believers about spiritual things, but to help build a people who know God, walk with God, discern His voice, and manifest the life of Christ in everyday living.
Three areas guide this podcast:
• Relationship with God
• Transformation of Self
• Relationship and Mission to the World
If you desire to grow beyond surface-level Christianity and learn what it means to live as a spiritual person, you're welcome here.
The Spiritual Man — Living by the Spirit.

title: The Flower Girl Perspective
author: Emily Hahn
description: The Flower Girl Perspective is a podcast about perspective, curiosity, and the stories that shape us. Each week, I sit down with strangers—and sometimes myself—to explore the moments that changed who we are. Through honest conversations about love, loss, faith, fear, healing, purpose, and everything in between, my hope is simple: that you leave feeling a little less alone, a little more understood, and a little more hopeful than when you arrived.

title: P.I.M.P PODCAST

description: You’ve heard their way of thinking now it’s time to hear my perspective.

The podcast where people tell the truth. Unmask. Dare to Open Up. Discuss the human side of success and what it truly takes to build something that lasts.

title: The Gulf Coast Sports Pulse with Gulf Coast Media
author: Gulf Coast Media
description:
The Gulf Coast Sports Pulse is a show dedicated to covering all things Baldwin County athletics.


Join sports editor Parker Gillam and local sports guru John Mullen as they recap the latest weekend of high school football in the area, discuss notable storylines and preview the slate of games to come.


If you like what you hear, be sure to share on social media and tell family, friends or whoever you think may be interested in a sports podcast with a Baldwin County twist.

title: U Talk UTAH.
author: Josh Bennett
description:
U Talk Utah is a town hall for the Utah community.
It’s a place where fans, athletes, media, former players, and voices from across Utah come together to share their thoughts, opinions, takes, stories, and experiences. We talk about all things Utah, but more importantly, we talk with the people who care about them.
U Talk Utah is built around real conversations — a place to listen, learn, debate, laugh, disagree, and hear perspectives you might not get anywhere else.
The conversation starts with U.

title: African Business Revolution — English
author: YannicK KOUNGA
description:
African Business Revolution is a pan-African business podcast for entrepreneurs, CEOs, founders and builders who want to build stronger companies, execute with discipline and scale with wisdom.

Hosted by YannicK KOUNGA, the show explores the realities of entrepreneurship across Africa and the Global South through practical lessons on strategy, execution, leadership, growth, innovation, resilience, digital transformation, partnerships and founder realities.

We go beyond motivational business talk.

We examine what it actually takes to build.

The wins.

The failures.

The systems.

The difficult decisions.

The African business cases.

The lessons learned from doing more with less.

Whether you are building from Douala, Lagos, Abidjan, Accra, Nairobi, Johannesburg — or from the diaspora — African Business Revolution exists to help you think better, decide better and execute better.

Build • Inspire • Execute • Scale

Visit: businessrevolution.africa

title: I Am That Woman: Becoming Her
author: Ngozi Anthony
description: A space for honest conversations, faith-filled encouragement, healing, relationships, and reminders that it’s never too late to start again. If you need a word to keep you going, you’re in the right place.

title: Sales Talk for CEOs
author: Alice Heiman
description: Welcome to Sales Talk for CEOs, where host Alice Heiman goes deep with female founders and experts on the real story behind building a company and a life at the same time. After 5+ years and 190+ episodes, the show has pivoted to focus exclusively on female founders/CEOs and their journeys on both the business and personal sides. In each episode, Alice explores not just what it took to build and grow a sales organization, but the full picture: getting funded, managing health and family, and driving revenue all at once. This is the founder story most podcasts don't tell.

title: Ctrl Shift
author: DeVante Pickering
description:
Ctrl Shift is an interview podcast about the shifts people make in their careers and lives, and the shortcuts they pick up along the way.
Host and Pick 2 Solutions Founder, DeVante Pickering, sits down with seasoned leaders and traces the whole arc: where they started, what changed, and what they learned navigating the turns. Every episode opens with the same question, "When you were younger, what did you want to be when you grew up?" and follows the honest path from that first answer to now. No highlight reels, no pretending it was a straight line, just real conversations about the pivots that shaped a career and the lessons worth passing on.
Ctrl Shift. Shortcuts for building longevity
New episodes every other Thursday. A good listen for your lunch break.

title: Logixly Live Unsupervised Learning Podcast
author: NLP Logix
description: Raw takes on AI, Tech and Innovation. Join NLP Logix's Logixly Live team as they break down the biggest tech news, emerging trends, and industry hot topics while sharing our insights and perspectives all under 30 minutes.

title: Building Brown and Beattie
author: Brown and Beattie
description: Welcome to the “Building Brown & Beattie” podcast! This podcast will explore all things Brown & Beattie, from the company’s history, to getting to know staff, colleagues, and partners, to issues of the day.

title: Stronger Mind
author: Travis Archer
description:
The Stronger Mind Podcast is for men done living burnt out, checked out, and stuck. For the man sitting in his car before walking inside—because home feels like failure, not peace.
That ends here.
This is your call to take ownership of your health, mind, and leadership. No more coasting. No more numbing out.
Whether you’re chasing success or barely holding it together, Travis Archer delivers high-impact, evidence-based strategies to rebuild your mindset, reclaim your strength, and lead with purpose.
A stronger mind isn’t optional. It’s the standard.

title: Be the Peace
author: Alive Community Outreach
description: A podcast featuring honest conversations with young people, survivors, Peacemakers, and community leaders about violence, nonviolence, and the pursuit of Beloved Community.

title: Disney Done Smarter Podcast
author: Tom Davidock
description: Disney Done Smarter helps you plan your Disney vacation easier, cheaper, and smarter. Hosted by Tom and Manisha, a Disney travel planner, each episode shares practical Disney vacation planning tips, money-saving strategies, and insider advice. From resorts and dining to Lightning Lanes, budgeting, and avoiding common mistakes, we help you create an amazing Disney trip without overspending or feeling overwhelmed. Whether it’s your first visit or your tenth, we’ll help you make Disney planning simpler and smarter.

title: Tiago's Lair
author: Tiago Azevedo
description: After 20 years on YouTube, Tiago Azevedo is launching Tiago's Lair: a podcast for real, unfiltered conversations about life, art, ideas, creativity, mental health, makeup, and everything in between. Hosted by artist Tiago Azevedo, the show draws from his life and journey as a painter, with occasional guests bringing new stories and perspectives. Honest, funny, positive, and no-BS, Tiago's Lair is a welcoming community where we can talk openly about depression, mental health awareness, arts and crafts, and the messy, meaningful, fun parts of being human.

title: The Daughters & Dads Cricket Podcast
author: The University of Newcastle
description:
This podcast is specifically for dads enrolled in the Daughters & Dads Cricket program. Listening to this podcast before attending the program with your daughter is a vital first step in your program experience.
Professor Philip Morgan and his team at the University of Newcastle translate current research on fathering and physical activity into practical tools. They empower fathers/father-figures to engage their daughters in cricket while fostering a calm, warm, and intentional parenting style, ensuring that daughters feel understood, valued, and empowered to thrive.

title: Advisor Elevated
author: Brieanna Carlson
description:
Real growth strategies and real advisor stories for advisors ready to build a business that scales. Hosted by Brieanna Carlson, CEO and Co-Founder of Advisor Elevated, this podcast is built on one idea: growth comes from systems, not guesswork.
Action Hour episodes are hands on coaching drawn from the AOS framework, each ending with a clear next step to take. Spotlights are candid conversations with advisors about what moved the needle, including the pivots and lessons learned along the way.
Whether you want the stories or the step by step, you'll know exactly which systems to build on next.

title: Nittany Talk - Penn State Football

description: Just a couch potato's outlook on Penn State football

description:
The Asante EDGE is a podcast from Asante Capital Group, bringing you inside the conversations shaping private markets today.
 
Through discussions with investors and fund managers, we explore where capital is moving, how strategies are evolving, and what it takes to build and back successful platforms.
 
Perspectives from across the global alternatives landscape.

title: Public Apology
author: Lock It In Studio
description:
Public Apology is a podcast about scandals from comedians Milo Edwards and Sophie Garrad and journalist and podcaster Ed Campbell. The show covers every kind of scandal from long ago and the present day, from the historical and political to pop culture fiascos and the occasional media circus about a cat in a bin. Public Apology is a wry, humorous look scandals and what they can tell us in an era of ‘cancel culture’.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Messy Middle | Scripture For Real Life
author: Laura Whitby
description:
Honest reflections on scripture, faith and finding God in the unfinished parts of life.
I’m not a theologian, and I don’t have God or life completely figured out. I’m simply trying to notice God while I’m still living the lesson.
Each episode includes a Bible reading, a real-life reflection and a closing prayer.

title: AstroTorah

description: Join astrologer Naomi Salfati, as she merges the worlds of Astrology and Torah.

Gennem personlige rejsefortællinger, konkrete anbefalinger og små dilemmaer kommer vi tættere på både mennesket og stedet – og får nye idéer til selv at tage af sted. En podcastserie fra Politiken, skabt i samarbejde med Norwegian.

title: Wild Kinship with Heather & Whitney
author: Heather Whitney
description:
Wild Kinship is a podcast exploring life outside the blueprint. Through honest conversations, we talk about chosen family, unconventional spirituality, parenting, womanhood, health, and the realities of navigating life when your path doesn't look like the one you were told to follow.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Jake Scannell Show
author: Jake Scannell
description: The "Jake Scannell Show" is hosted by Jake Scannell, former Local 40 Ironworker and Founder of Lendeavor Group LLC. We dive deep into the extraordinary lives of people from all walks of life. Our mission goes beyond just entertainment. We deliver authenticity and insight from real people with real stories. Enjoy the show!

title: Your Story
author: Monti Rossetti
description: Your Story with StoryStudio takes you inside the ideas, people, and strategies shaping modern marketing at Hearst.  Join leaders, marketers, sales teams, and creative minds from across the company as they share the trends they’re watching, the lessons they’ve learned, and the ideas driving meaningful connections between brands and audiences.  From creative strategy and storytelling to emerging trends and the future of media, each episode offers a fresh perspective on what’s next in marketing.  Tune in for the conversations, insights, and inspiration behind the work,  and discover the stories shaping what’s next at Hearst.

author: Daquan Kiah
description:
Welcome to Keeping Up With Quan 🎙️♒️
Unfiltered thoughts from a mind that was never meant to fit inside the box. Quan dives into self-discovery, relationships, boundaries, healing, human behavior, and the uncomfortable truths people would rather leave unsaid.
Sometimes deep. Sometimes funny. Always authentic.
This isn’t about following the crowd. It’s about questioning it, challenging it, and choosing yourself anyway.
You may agree. You may feel called out. You may leave seeing things completely differently.
Either way… keep up. 👽✨

description: Produced by the Adubato Center for Media Leadership, in cooperation with a consortium of media organizations and leaders who are committed to promoting independent and impactful journalism in an effort to protect and preserve our representative democracy, the Steve Adubato’s Media Matters podcast will include compelling conversations focused on why having strong and independent media is critical to informing and engaging our citizens, which is essential to a functioning American society.

title: Vitalize Wellness Podcast
author: Chelsea Nab, APRN & Dr. Georgia Nab
description: The Vitalize Wellness Podcast brings practical, honest conversations about health, wellness, and longevity to help you feel your best at every stage of life. Hosted by Dr. Georgia Nab, chiropractor and functional medicine practitioner, and Chelsea Nab, board-certified nurse practitioner and functional medicine practitioner, each episode goes beyond the symptoms to explore the why behind your health—and the small, actionable changes that can make a lasting difference. Vitality Through Every Breath.

title: Single Mom Time With Jesus Podcast
author: Stephanie Gibson
description:
Single Mom Time With Jesus Podcast is a safe space for single moms to slow down, breathe, and spend time with God. Through short devotions, real-life encouragement, and scripture, this podcast helps you find peace, strength, and purpose in your everyday journey with Jesus.
Matthew 28:19;20
Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you; and lo I am with you always, even to the end of age.

title: Hard to Love
author: myishathill
description:
We're all a little hard to love. We get defensive, we go quiet, we protect the soft parts by pushing people away, and then we wonder why the distance grows. Hard to Love is a podcast about what it takes to stay anyway.


Each episode is an honest conversation about the messy, tender work of being in relationship, with our people, our communities, and ourselves. We talk about love and conflict and repair not as problems to solve but as a practice to return to, again and again. Because being human with other humans was never meant to be done perfectly. It was meant to be done together.


Brought to you by The Heal Your Way Forward Collective, where we believe that healing is relational, that conflict is a teacher, and that the way forward is one we build in collective community.

Welcome to the world of DASSY. 🌎🔥
A podcast rooted in Caribbean energy, music, culture, and everything in between. Expect high-energy Soca and Dancehall mixes, conversations with artists and creatives, exclusive sounds, and a behind-the-scenes look at the culture shaping the Caribbean and its influence around the world.
From Toronto to Trinidad and everywhere in between, DASSY brings the energy, the stories, and the sounds straight to you.
Press play. Turn it up. Welcome to DASSY.

title: The Maker Dad
author: Josh Bailey
description:
Join me as I document my journey from live-streaming to the workshop. I'm a dad who traded the webcam for wood glue and sawdust, and I'm learning woodworking one project at a time.

In each episode, we'll explore what it really takes to build a maker practice without breaking the bank. From workshop organization and tool choices to tackling first projects and avoiding the "you're not serious if you don't overspend" mentality, this is an honest look at the ups, downs, and lessons learned along the way.

Whether you're a seasoned woodworker, a curious beginner, or someone who just loves making things with their hands, you'll find practical insights, real talk about mistakes, and encouragement to start building, no matter where you are in your journey.

New episodes every week. Grab your tea, fire up the table saw (safely), and let's get to work.

title: Beyond Wellness with Dr. Jones
author: Dr. Jones
description:
Beyond Wellness with Dr. Jones


Health is more than a number on a lab report. Wellness is about the whole person.


Beyond Wellness with Dr. Jones is a podcast dedicated to conversations that go beyond traditional approaches to health and explore what it truly means to live stronger, healthier, and with purpose.

Hosted by Dr. Richard Jones, the show brings together healthcare professionals, veterans, first responders, athletes, business leaders, community advocates, and everyday people with powerful stories and valuable perspectives.


From wellness, recovery, performance, and healthy aging to mental resilience, leadership, service, and overcoming adversity, Beyond Wellness explores the many factors that shape how we live, perform, recover, and serve others.


Through the work and communities surrounding Apex One Wellness and Wellness for Warriors, the podcast also shines a light on those who serve and the people and organizations working to make a difference in their lives.


Expect real conversations. Real experiences. Expert perspectives. And stories that remind us that wellness is about more than simply feeling better.


It is about living better.

Beyond Wellness with Dr. Jones

Going beyond health. Building stronger lives and stronger communities.

title: The United States of Us
author: Tammy Green Mitchell and Lori Walpole
description:
Two friends. Almost forty years of shared history. Two lives shaped by different choices, different experiences, and different political paths. Yet beneath every divergence, one truth endured. Love never left.

This stands as proof of what still exists beneath the noise. Hear honest conversations about politics, identity, aging, relationships, healing, and the unseen forces that shape human life. Nothing is off limits. Nothing is scripted. Witness what becomes possible when two people choose presence over position, listening over certainty, and love over division. Love still binds us.

author: Melissa Odom
description: Off the Script is an unscripted look at what it actually takes to be a travel advisor. This is the craft, the doubts, and the wins that never make it to a caption. By Melissa Odom, owner of Trouvaille Discoveries, a cruise and travel advisor specializing in Alaska group travel and multi-generational cruise planning for cruise lines like Holland America, Princess Cruises and Virgin Voyages. Each episode is a raw documentary-style conversation about what it takes to be an advisor behind the scenes. It goes into detail about the imposter syndrome that no one names out loud, the moments that clients have that shape how she works, and what it is actually like to sell places that you love for a living.

author: Twinkl Australia
description:
The Better Question is Twinkl Australia’s podcast for educators who want to think deeper about teaching, learning and the future of education. 
Hosted by James Lister, Twinkl’s Head of Curriculum, each episode explores issues shaping classrooms, from curriculum and pedagogy to inclusion, technology, wellbeing and the changing role of teachers. We go beyond quick answers, bringing together teachers, principals, educationalists and experts behind Twinkl’s resources for informed and thought-provoking conversations.

title: Following the Trucks — A Heat Island Register Podcast
author: Michelle Baldwin
description:
I went camping in September 2025 to unplug from my job marketing AI software. I found unmarked trucks instead — running all night on a Utah highway I didn't recognize. In the morning, I followed the road.

Following the Trucks traces the supply chain that powers artificial intelligence — from a coal mine in Carbon County, Utah, to the Great Salt Lake. Twelve episodes. Twelve chapters. One narrator who is part of the problem she's investigating.

Michelle Baldwin is the author of Coal: Book One of the Fuel the Future Trilogy, publication forthcoming. She is a principal marketing manager for Adobe Creative Cloud's AI platform and a Wasatch Front, Utah resident.

New episodes every Thursday. The written version of this work lives at heatislandregister.substack.com.

title: Guardians of Care
author: AmeriTrust Solutions
description:
Medicaid provides healthcare coverage to millions of Americans. Behind its policies and programs are people working every day to make the system work better.

Guardians of Care, a podcast from AmeriTrust Solutions hosted by Pete Justen, is about the people who make Medicaid work—and the people it works for. Pete sits down with state leaders, hospital teams, program operators, advocates, and Medicaid members to uncover the successes that rarely make headlines.

Through thoughtful, solution-focused, and nonpartisan conversations, guests share what they built, how they made it work, who it helped, and what others across the Medicaid community can learn from their experience. The show highlights what is going right and the people committed to building on that progress.

New episodes every other week on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube.

title: The ERA Podcast with Bryony and Nash
author: Elite Rugby Academy
description:
The ERA Podcast with Bryony and Nash gives ambitious rugby players and their parents an honest, practical look at what it takes to develop, access opportunities and progress towards elite sport.

Drawing on ERA’s experience in player development and high-performance coaching, Bryony and Nash explore the technical, physical and mental demands of the game. They discuss how players can train more effectively, make better decisions, navigate academies and performance pathways, and take greater ownership of their development.

The podcast is for players who want to improve, parents who want to support them effectively, and coaches committed to creating better development environments.

No hype. No shortcuts. Just clear guidance on becoming a better player and building a genuine pathway through rugby.

title: Bear Hunt
author: Goalhanger
description:
350 British civilians are dead and Russia is responsible. Number 10 hits back as a hapless Prime Minister plays his hand in the age of regime decapitation.
Bear Hunt is a technically rigorous action drama exploring the political manoeuvres, operational challenges and conflict expertise required to assassinate a head of state.
Billed as a British Bourne, this geopolitical thriller pulls listeners into the white-hot corridors of power in Westminster and Washington. To the battlefields where the nation’s best learnt their killing trade. And to the mission itself, deep behind enemy lines.
Goalhanger’s award-winning drama team worked with current and former military and defence professionals to shape the most accurate and daring mission conceivable: a forensic exploration of what it takes, in the modern age, to kill the President of the Russian Federation.

title: Success Curious with Andy Reid
author: Andy Reid
description:
Performing well and actually feeling good are two very different things. Success Curious is where that gap gets explored out loud. Andy Reid built a multi-million-dollar business before 30 and was named Australia's #1 auctioneer in 2022 — and still had to learn that the hard way.
Each episode is a real, unscripted conversation — with Paralympians, entrepreneurs, criminal lawyers, authors and everyday people who've had to rebuild their own definition of success — built around four things: Energy, Identity, Optimism, Practicality. It's the companion podcast to Andy's book of the same name, and part of Success Curious's wider mission to help make the world feel good again.
New episodes twice monthly. Full video episodes on YouTube (Andy Reid Coaching). Follow along on Instagram & Facebook @success_curious. More at andyreid.com.au.

title: Forged with Pasha & Mick
author: Mick Hunt, Pasha Palanker
description:
Some moments break you. The right ones forge you. Every week, Pasha Palanker and Mick Hunt go inside the moments that shape who we become.
Pasha and Mick have spent years on stages across the country, and the thing audiences always come back to isn't the wins. It's the moments. The promise made at ten years old. The turnaround that worked on paper and cost everything culturally. The scar you're most proud of.
So they built a show around it.

title: Permission with Jamie Scrimgeour
author: Jamie Scrimgeour
description:
Formerly The KICK-ASS Stepmom Podcast | After spending nearly a decade building one of the world's largest communities for stepmoms, Jamie Scrimgeour is entering a new chapter.
What started as conversations about stepfamily life became something much bigger. Because women weren't only coming back for stepmom advice. They were coming back for a different way of thinking. 
About themselves. Their relationships. Their businesses.  What they wanted and the lives they were creating. 
Women spend a lot of time waiting for permission they don't actually need. Permission is about what happens when women stop waiting. Permission to say no. To set the boundary. To change their minds. To buy the jeans. To ask for the better table. To start the business. To book the trip. To do things differently.

title: Elliott James: Unscripted

description: From reality television to the larger world of pop culture, Elliott James takes on the stories she can’t stop thinking about—and the details everyone else seems to miss. Smart, conversational and always opinionated, Elliott James: Unscripted is for people who appreciate the absurd and aren’t afraid to mention it all.

Mastery of Self by Black Swan Mindset is a mental wellbeing and self-discovery podcast exploring subconscious patterns, self-worth, emotional wellbeing, relationships, identity, and personal growth. Through compassionate reflections and grounded therapeutic perspectives, each episode offers clarity, encouragement, and space to understand yourself more deeply, soften self-judgement, and create meaningful, sustainable change. 
Season One: Kind Reminders for Tired Souls

description:
The CMMC Hot Mic is where the Defense Industrial Base comes to hear the conversations shaping cybersecurity, compliance, and government contracting.


Hosted by Regis DeVeaux, The GovCon CMMC Nerd, the show brings together defense contractor owners, CMMC authorities, GovCon leaders, attorneys, assessors, cybersecurity professionals, and industry connectors for candid conversations about what it really takes to compete, grow, and protect sensitive information in the federal marketplace.


Some episodes go inside the businesses navigating the realities of government contracting. Others bring in the experts interpreting CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, assessments, enforcement, and emerging cybersecurity requirements.


No generic webinars. No compliance theater. Just practical conversations about what contractors are facing, what the experts are seeing, and what business leaders should do next.


Operators. Authorities. Influencers. One mic.


Welcome to The CMMC Hot Mic.

author: Mike Fritz
description:
The Machine Shop Growth Podcast gives a fresh perspective to help you grow your shop by focusing on 3 key factors - Sales, Marketing and Efficiency.  For decades the machine shop industry was build on a “good-ol-boys” mentality and was full of great machinists and engineers that made great parts.  What has been discovered is many of those amazing shops have plateaued or are starting to decline - because they didn’t put enough emphasis on getting more work and making more money with the work they had.  

On this podcast you will hear first hand advice from machine owners and mangers how they are getting more work and how they are making more money.   Now let’s Grow Your Shop!

description:
The Voices of Learning Podcast with AISB is a thought-provoking series on education, featuring educators, specialists, and school leaders sharing how young people prepare for a constantly changing world.
Hosted by Magdalen Gray from the American International School of Budapest, it explores topics like what it means to be “future-ready” and how schools and families can work better together.
Designed for parents, educators, and anyone supporting the next generation, it offers clear, practical perspectives on learning today.

title: Becoming-Women with Kate Shiloh
author: Kate Shiloh
description: Becoming-Women is a project created by Kate Shiloh with intro music by Nicole Weisberg. This is a space for deep, unfiltered conversation between women, the kind you’d have around a kitchen table. No offers, no funnels, just complete presence. Each episode, Kate invites a different guest to reflect on the future of womanhood: where we’ve been, where we’re headed, and how we begin to write a story that isn’t dictated by patriarchy’s agenda.Together, they ask what it actually looks like to build a different kind of society, one rooted in truth, intuition, feminine power, and true connection.

title: Two Sisters One Loss

description:
Two Sisters One Loss is a podcast where sisters Tami & Tosh have honest conversations about womanhood, family, healing, grief, and navigating life's different seasons after losing their Mum.
Through laughter, reflection, and real-life experiences, we talk about the moments that shape us. The hard moments, the funny ones, the chaos, and everything in between.
If you've experienced loss, are navigating life without someone you love, or simply want a reminder that you're not alone, you're in the right place.
Two sisters, one loss, and a lifetime of stories.

title: Historier Fra Teenagevaerelset
author: HistorierFraTeenagevaerelset
description: Teenagelivet er et af de sygeste tidspunkter i dit liv. Ingen aner hvad de laver, men alle lader som de gør. Og imens du svømmer rundt i et helt nyt og vanvittigt følelsesliv proppet til randen med hormoner, så skal du finde ud af hvem du er. Det er rimelig unfair hold. Derfor har jeg lavet den her podcast – Så vi kan dele vores oplevelser og måske lære lidt af hinanden. Her inviterer jeg en gæst tilbage på deres teenageværelse, hvor de deler tre historier: En historie om noget de dengang syntes var vildt pinligt, en historie, om noget som var svært og en historie, hvor de følte sig pisseseje, modige, eller måske bare helt sig selv for første gang. Mit navn er Philip Svinding, og du lytter til Historier fra Teenageværelset. Velkommen indenfor!

title: Life After Grief With Indigo
author: Indigo
description:
Life After Grief with Indigo is an honest and supportive space for exploring grief in all its forms. Whether you’re navigating the loss of someone you love, heartbreak, life transitions, changing relationships, or simply trying to find yourself again, you’re welcome here.


Together, we’ll explore what grief is, how it affects us, and the many ways it can show up throughout our lives. Through personal stories, psychology, lived experiences, meaningful conversations, practical tools, a little humor, the occasional dark joke, and a swear word here and there, we’ll make space for the different ways we grieve, heal, grow, and rediscover ourselves after life changes us.


Because grief looks different for everyone, this podcast will share different voices, experiences, and forms of loss as we navigate life after grief, one step at a time.

WANT MORE? FOLLOW ALONG
@lifeaftergriefpodcast


With music and podcast support by Carlo Ferrer.


Disclaimer: This podcast is for educational and informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional mental health care.

title: RREpresentED
author: NSW Department of Education
description: A podcast for teachers and leaders exploring gender equality and the complex social forces shaping young people and their relationships.

title: Tell Us What You Really Think? with Graham Higgins
author: Graham Higgins
description:
Local issues. Current affairs. Different points of view. And plenty to talk about.
Join Graham Higgins for Tell Us What You Really Think?, a program that puts conversation and the issues that matter to our community front and centre.
Graham Higgins has never been short of something to say! He’s been asking questions and sharing his thoughts for most of his life — from earning the nickname “The Commentator” in Grade One, to a career in radio journalism that saw him reading news for 26 stations across Queensland. Add experience in politics and local business, including his years at Toowoomba’s Vacy Hall, and Graham brings a unique perspective to the microphone.
Each week, Graham explores what’s happening around Toowoomba and the Darling Downs, tackles the stories making news and gives locals the chance to join the conversation.
Got something to say? Tell us what you really think!

title: SuperLife with Darin Olien
author: Darin Olien
description:
I'm Darin Olien, the "Superfood Hunter." 
If you're looking for motivation to take the next step towards a happier, healthier life then you're in the right place.
On this podcast, you'll hear honest conversations with extraordinary people that educate and inspire me. We cover everything from nutrition and mental health to sustainable ways of living.
We also dive into life's Fatal Conveniences™. These are the things that we're doing or consuming in our day-to-day life that may actually be harming us, or the Earth.

title: Crosshairs
author: Lucas Neumeyer
description: Crosshairs is a show about the most interesting assassinations in world history. Host Lucas Neumeyer blends thrilling action with historical context to provide gripping accounts on important murders. Whether in times of peace or times of war, whether against the state or against the people, behind every assassination, there is a story.

think late-night voice note energy, mild chaos, and overanalysing things that probably don’t need analysing.

title: Annexstad Family Foundation Podcast
author: Annexstad Family Foundation
description: The Annexstad Family Foundation Podcast is a platform designed to support scholars and alumni through practical guidance, expert perspectives, and real-life experiences. Each episode explores topics that help listeners invest in themselves and navigate college, career decisions, and early professional life with greater confidence. Through conversations with alumni, professionals, educators, and other thought leaders, the podcast provides actionable insights on personal, professional, and financial growth while strengthening connections across the Annexstad community.

title: The Space Oddities
author: Josh Keegan, Tom Dune, Jim Clelland
description:
A podcast, brought to you by The Space Oddities, fueled by caffeine and whisky. Join Tom, Josh and Jim as they talk all things space and science.
Josh Keegan is the host of Aussienaut,
Tom Dune is the host of UK Space News,
Jim Cleland works in the aerospace sector and is the glue that holds it all together.
Three mates | YouTubers | one shared passion
Just don't encourage them!

And remember... Stay caffeinated!

title: The Dr Dylan Podcast
author: Dylan C Wyatt, MD
description:
Welcome to The Dr. Dylan Podcast! Hosted by ER Medical Director Dr. Dylan Wyatt and veteran television host Baihly Warfield, we translate the complicated world of medicine into something we can all actually understand.
We’re cutting through late-night WebMD panic and viral health trends to give you real, practical advice. No dry lectures, no slide decks, and zero heavy medical jargon—if things get too technical, Baihly calls a "Time Out, Nerds!" to break it down.
Our mission is simple: to take the anxiety out of your healthcare. Hit Follow to tune in!

EU CyberNet podcast series bridges the expertise from EU CyberNet's Expert Pool and its partners to wider cybersecurity and cyber capacity building community on people, policies and practices shaping cybersecurity globally.
